title: Turn on Dark mode in Windows
prerequisites: Windows is in Light mode. Settings opens on the Colors page.
concept: Windows can show everything light or dark. The switch is in Settings, under Personalization, then Colors, and I've opened that page for you.
recap: You turned on Dark mode: Settings, Personalization, Colors, then Choose your mode.

check.question: Quick check: which box switches Windows between light and dark?
check.explain: Choose your mode changes Windows and your apps together.

speech.demonstrate: Click the box next to Choose your mode, on the right. A short list opens.
speech.guide: Open the Choose your mode box.
speech.hint: Which setting near the top picks how all of Windows looks?

steps.explain: This one box switches Windows and your apps between light and dark.

speech.demonstrate: Click Dark. The whole screen turns dark straight away.
speech.hint: Three choices. Which one is easier on the eyes at night?

steps.explain: Dark mode uses light text on dark backgrounds, which is easier on your eyes in low light.

mistakes.correction: Custom mixes light and dark. Open the box again and pick Dark.
That kept Light. Open the box again and pick Dark.
